text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now for the decisive moment!! How will 
they make their move from here?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: M-My—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Raaaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria breaks away!!! Gran 
Alegriaaaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Gran Alegria puts on a show of 
unprecedented speed!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Mmm!! Feels so gooood~~!! Happy 120 mph-!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheers!! Give me more and more 
of theeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Gran Alegria is a beast! With that 
overwhelming speed, she's gotta be like 
two cuts above the rest of her 
generation!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her potential is insane...! Now I've got 
high hopes for the Oaks, too...!

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Loves-chan was so close...! But you 
really gave it your all...! Great job!"

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"So close!!" "Great guts!" "You were 
awesome, Loves-chan!" "On to the next!" 
"Good work out there!" "Glad you're 
safe~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it... Gran-chan in the mile... is 
utterly overwhelming...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I still have a long way to go... I was 
careless at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Chrono-chan—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Next time, it won't go like this.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
My "Genesis Method" will... definitely 
conquer Gran-chan... and conquer the races 
ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I can't just stay like this 
either♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I'll definitely prove at the 
Oaks that my running is the strongest of 
all...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue to spur each other on. 
—Next time, beneath the crown of the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.
choice_data_list: Still, that was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Although we didn't win, we gained plenty 
of fruitful results for the next race. 
Today's defeat will surely become fuel for 
the future...!"
choice_data_list: We're the ones who will win the Oaks.

We're the ones who are going to win the 
Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. You're trying a little too hard 
to look cool♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— That's what I love about you, 
though♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...We have to win the Oaks, no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, while victory eluded her in 
the Oka Sho, the race gave her the 
strength to take another step forward—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
――So you won't be running in the Japanese 
Oaks, but instead heading for the NHK Mile 
Cup for your next race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I plan on aiming for the 'Alternative 
Double Crown'!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
While many fans were hoping for the Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks), what was the reason 
behind this course change? Was it 
distance, after all?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um, there are all sorts of reasons, but 
the most important one is—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to prove a kind of 
'strongest' that only I can achieve!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone! That the Triple Crown 
isn't the only path to being the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Tonight's a casual chat stream~! How's 
everyone doing lately? It's a new season, 
so I bet you're all pretty busy♪

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"Time flies~" "Work is crazy right now" 
"Gran-chan is skipping the Yushun Himba" 
"Sleepy season" "The Yushun Himba is 
coming right up"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh♪ —Ah, I saw Gran-chan too~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I was a little surprised, but... it's so 
like Gran-chan to stay true to herself. 
...I think that's really cool.

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"She was so strong in the Oka Sho, after 
all." "She might've been a tough rival in 
the Oaks too." "Her speed is seriously 
insane."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'm sure Gran-chan is going to be 
the one blazing trails at the very 
forefront of our generation. But—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show off the best run I 
trained for at my own pace in the Oaks, 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whether Gran-chan is at the Oaks or not 
doesn't matter. I will prove it to the 
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Gran-chan isn't the only Tiara Umamusume 
this year. I'm here too!

text_block_list.name: Comments Section
text_block_list.text:
"So cool!!" "Sasuga Loves~~↑↑" "So hyped 
★" "Watch out, racing world!" "Keep it 
up!" "I'm coming to see the Oaks!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You stays positive even on her 
streams. Her community members are also 
eagerly looking forward to what she does 
next...
choice_data_list: (I need to follow that example too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the path ahead of Loves Only You, many 
Umamusume would stand as formidable 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention her peers, the chance to 
compete against the senior Umamusume who 
came before them might not be that far 
off—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter who the opponent is, I 
will do everything within my power to 
seize victory alongside Loves Only You.
choice_data_list: (That is my role as a bridge.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks will soon be upon us. As if it 
can hardly wait for the birth of a new 
Queen of the Oaks—"
